## Checklist

- [ ] Exact base/head verified
- [ ] Allowed paths only
- [ ] No unrelated dirty files
- [ ] Tests verify behavior and failure paths
- [ ] No secrets committed or logged
- [ ] PR remains Draft until CTO review
- [ ] Local validation completed or explicitly not required
- [ ] Deployment commit matches tested commit
- [ ] PR body matches actual diff and evidence

## Status

Developer status:

- [ ] READY FOR CTO RE-REVIEW — DO NOT MERGE
- [ ] BLOCKED — DO NOT MERGE

CTO final status:

- [ ] NOT REVIEWED
- [ ] READY
- [ ] CONDITIONALLY READY
- [ ] NOT READY
- [ ] BLOCKED

User merge approval:

- [ ] NOT GRANTED
- [ ] GRANTED

개발자는 Developer status만 갱신합니다. CTO final status와 User merge approval는 각각 웹 CTO와 사용자·제품 책임자만 갱신할 수 있으며, 개발자가 대신 체크해서는 안 됩니다.
